concerns.text: Phase 6 (T031–T041) introduces 'Blind Agent', 'Forgetting', 'Noise', and 'Consolidation' mechanisms. These are entirely absent from spec.md (FR-001 to FR-012) and plan.md. This constitutes unapproved scope creep that violates the spec's fixed requirements and risks invalidating the reproducibility of the core transactive-memory metrics defined in SC-001/SC-005.

Task T033 implements 'prune_stale_entries()' to remove memory entries. This violates Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) which states 'No data may be modified in place' and 'Raw data is preserved unchanged'. Pruning implies in-place deletion of interaction logs required for reproducibility.

Tasks T011, T011b, T018, T022, and T027 contain unresolved '{{claim:...}}' placeholders and '<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->' markers. These tasks fail to define concrete implementation steps for dataset loading, game simulation, and sensitivity analysis, making them unexecutable and violating the requirement for deterministic task definitions.

Tasks T039 ('Consolidation Cost' metric) and T041 ('Scaling Limit' check) define new metrics and flags with no corresponding Success Criteria (SC-*) or Functional Requirement (FR-*) in spec.md. Their verification criteria are subjective and their inclusion is unauthorized.

Task T030 is marked as failed/rejected in the text ('No scaling_plot.pdf file is present') yet remains listed as a pending task without a re-planned, verifiable sub-step. This creates a high risk of implementation waste and violates the requirement for executable task definitions.
